title: The agent SYSTEM PROMPT still instructs the worker to read prd.json and pick th…
description:
The agent SYSTEM PROMPT still instructs the worker to read prd.json and pick the highest-priority passes:false story (lines 3, 35, 69), which now contradicts the injected spawn prompt's 'do not self-select' directive. This is explicitly out of scope for this PR (PRD notes assign it to CAM-229) and is therefore non-blocking, but the context-diet is only fully realized once CAM-229 lands.

Source: cam/issue-224
Review round: 1
Location: .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md:35

suggestion-fingerprint: 0e9df68b6f24

acceptanceCriteria: In .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md, the self-selection instructions are reconciled to the injected-story model: the frontmatter description (line ~3) no longer says the worker 'picks highest-priority story'; the 'find the highest-priority story where passes:false / exit PRD_COMPLETE' instruction (line ~35), the jq self-selection block (lines ~48-55), and the 'skip requires:operator when picking' selection-logic line (line ~69) are removed or rewritten to state that the story to implement is provided in the spawn prompt (id, title, description, priority, requires, acceptanceCriteria, branchName).
The wording mirrors the already-reconciled scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md ('The story to implement is provided in the spawn prompt ...; you do not read prd.json in full to self-select it').
templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md receives the identical reconciliation (the self-select instructions are byte-identical to the .claude copy today, so both must be updated).

The stale quoted implementer task-prompt block in .claude/commands/cam-next.md (lines ~66-70, still showing the generic 'Implement the next user story' form) is updated to reflect that the sidecar injects a specific pre-selected story.

The worker's write of prd.json to flip passes:true for the completed story (line ~111) and any read of prd.json for context are PRESERVED — only the SELECTION instructions are reconciled, not all prd.json access.

typecheck and the full test suite pass green, including any embedded-vendor / doc-gate / check-count assertions over the implementer md and cam-next.md; run embed-vendor regeneration if templates/ change requires it.
spec.scope: Reconcile the implementer agent SYSTEM PROMPT (both .claude and templates copies) and the stale cam-next.md quoted prompt with the actual dispatch contract: the sidecar's decideNextAction (decide.ts) authoritatively selects the story and task-prompt.ts injects it with an explicit 'do not self-select' directive. Remove the dead jq self-selection logic from the implementer md; do NOT change any TS (decide.ts / task-prompt.ts / loop.ts are already correct). Docs-only.
gotchas: The sidecar already injects the exact story and forbids re-selection (task-prompt.ts:31); decideNextAction (decide.ts:83) is the authoritative selector (passes!=true && requires!=operator, sort priority then id). The agent md's jq (lines 48-55) duplicates this predicate but is dead at runtime. This is docs drift, not a code bug.

The same reconciliation was ALREADY applied to scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (templates + vendored _generated.ts) but not to the agent md or cam-next.md — mirror that existing wording rather than inventing new phrasing.
Preserve the worker's prd.json WRITE (flip passes:true, line ~111) and any context reads; the fix is only about removing self-SELECTION, not all prd.json interaction.
The requires:operator concept explanation (agent md line ~67) can stay as context; only the selection-logic sentence (line ~69) that says the worker skips them 'when picking' is dead.
If templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md changes, regenerate the embedded vendor copy (bun run embed-vendor) or the embed-vendor:check gate will fail.
